text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What an unexpected result. I<n>guess I should
have expected no less<n>from the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The stronger my opponents are, the<n>stronger I'll
become, just as a pearl<n>grows larger over time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, today's narrow<n>defeat has served
to expand my<n>possibilities even more!
choice_data_list: Can I take you at your word on that?
Can I take you at your word on that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha... thanks. But I've got my sights<n>set on the
world stage, so I can't<n>allow myself to be held to
such<n>lenient standards.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And to even further elevate my<n>pursuit, we have to
get out there and<n>train! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Just sit back, relax, and<n>leave everything
to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stand directly by my side so you can<n>bear witness
to the moment I rewrite<n>history!
